arguments.draft: The latest approved AI tools policy update includes the requirement to submit an intake form before building or buying any AI solution. Every unit has a free monthly allowance on the approved tools. This policy applies to every member of staff who uses generative AI tools for work. Staff remain accountable for any output they use, whatever tool produced it. The forwarded notes mention an approved AI tools policy update, but do not provide key points. According to the AI Use Case Intake Procedure, the key points in the forwarded notes are not specified. However, the procedure does mention that costs are covered by the free monthly allowance.
